facts.fact: Algeria's Loi n° 18-05 of 10 May 2018, printed in Journal officiel n° 28 of 16 May 2018, sets general rules for e-commerce of goods and services: registration of e-suppliers, electronic offers and contracts, payment, advertising and penalties.
facts.system: Loi n° 18-05 relative au commerce électronique

systems.system: Loi n° 18-05 relative au commerce électronique

note: Articles 7 and 25 leave their terms to regulation; the text names no decree made.
